provenance.buyerQuestion: When an AI video tool finds nothing worth making from my footage, will it say so, or just show me an empty screen?
provenance.targetQuery: how an ai video tool should report that it found no story in your footage

approval.approvedBy: operator:claude-code, acting as ShortsOS CTO/CMO under the owner's instruction of 2026-10-26 to run a Commit-to-Content wave for ShortsOS and feed ShortsOS-site

source.quote: P2 review of candidate 40ec93a returned FAIL: the provider "failed" outcome is silently discarded, and a truthful zero-strong-opportunities result is indistinguishable from the destination page's "not analyzed yet" empty state.

limitations: Governance commit written by the product team about its own review; it records the verdict, it does not independently prove the defect.

source.quote: a provider "failed" outcome now redirects to the Media tab with a visible error banner instead of being silently discarded
now redirects to the Opportunities tab with distinct copy ("Analysis complete -- no strong opportunities yet") instead of being indistinguishable from the "never analyzed" empty state.

Closes a real, previously-unflagged idempotency gap: content_opportunities has no unique constraint and createOpportunity used no onConflictDoNothing, so calling generateOpportunities twice for the same client inserted a duplicate set of rows.
The new caller checks findSnapshotByHash + isSnapshotReferenced first and returns the existing opportunities (status: "already_generated") instead of regenerating.
gated on a P2 product-experience review (one FAIL, one narrow fix, one PASS) before publish per PROTOCOL.md §10.
Une sortie techniquement correcte mais perceptiblement médiocre échoue à P2.

limitations: Internal working protocol, in French; it states the rule the review applies, not the outcome of any particular review.

source.quote: generateOpportunities now find-or-creates a client_strategy_snapshot on the no_strong_story_available path too (reusing the exact success-path mechanism via a shared helper), not only on success.
This makes the truthful "Analysis complete -- no strong opportunities yet" empty state durable: it now survives a plain page revisit
no_candidates and failed outcomes are explicitly untouched -- no snapshot persisted for either, so they continue to read as "not yet analyzed," never as a false "we tried and found nothing."
no_candidates is classified the same as 'never analyzed', a defensible but non-blocking ambiguity noted at P2.
P2 pass notes the error banner surfaces a raw provider-generated reason string, developer-phrased — acceptable but not polished customer copy.

slots.writingObjective: Name the change in plain words, as a grounded fact about ShortsOS: an empty result and a result of nothing found are now shown apart.
One sentence a search result can show: a review failed a build that hid two outcomes, and the fix shows each one apart.

Open with the buyer's stake: an empty screen can mean the tool looked and found nothing, or never looked, or broke. Then say that ShortsOS had this exact ambiguity and that a review caught it before release.
slots.buyerIntent: Will I be able to tell what an empty result means?

slots.heading: What was wrong, and what changed?
slots.writingObjective: Answer directly: which two outcomes were hidden, and what each one shows after the fix.
slots.buyerIntent: What exactly did the screen get wrong?

slots.heading: A review that failed a working build
slots.writingObjective: Explain the product-experience review: its rule that technically correct but perceptibly poor output fails, and its record on this change (one fail, one narrow fix, one pass) before release.
slots.buyerIntent: Who checks what the operator actually sees?

slots.heading: Making the honest answer survive a revisit
slots.writingObjective: Describe the follow-up change: the nothing-found outcome is now recorded so it survives a revisit, while outcomes where nothing was really analyzed are deliberately not recorded that way.
slots.buyerIntent: Will the answer still be there tomorrow?

slots.heading: What else was fixed, and what is still rough
slots.writingObjective: Report the duplicate-rows gap closed in the same change, then state plainly the two limits the review recorded as still open.
slots.buyerIntent: What does the vendor admit is not finished?
